title: ci.yml go job is red: the contract-parity step still names the deleted ./internal/herd/collect package
body: .github/workflows/ci.yml:69 runs `go test -short ./internal/herd/collect/...`, but tick nkf deleted internal/herd/collect, so the step fails with `pattern ./internal/herd/collect/...: lstat ...: no such file or directory [setup failed]` (exit 1). The go job has no path filter and runs on every pull_request and push, so the epic's integration PR cannot go green and the close-out rule that requires green CI is unsatisfiable until the line is deleted. The integrated gates never caught it because they ran `go test -short ./...`, which passes, and never re-ran the workflow's own named-package step.
